description: This file defines a PHP trait named IndexingStatisticsTrait within the SuiteCRM search indexing module. The trait provides methods and properties for collecting, reporting, and resetting search indexing statistics such as counts of modules, records, fields, and removed records.

methods.name: getRemovedRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of removed records from the last indexing operation.

methods.name: getIndexedRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of indexed records (beans).

methods.name: getIndexedFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of indexed fields.

methods.name: getIndexedModulesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of modules indexed.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Logs detailed statistics about the indexing process, including counts, elapsed time, and estimated time for processing more records.

methods.name: resetCounts
methods.description: Resets all indexing counters to zero.
